baseline.notes: The designated AwesomeSalesforceSkills-main (3).zip archive was mounted and hashed. Its SHA-256 matches the earlier inspectable (1).zip fallback byte-for-byte, so reconciliation used commit 7e0ecaba888f3d986362782f04d7035064bfce34 created from the (3) extract as the exact latest baseline. Upstream candidate archives remain unavailable for byte-level pins.

pin.reason: The user-supplied archive was not mounted, so no archive hash, commit, or tag is asserted for the reviewed snapshot.

sources.content_use: Catalog and benchmark-claim discovery only. No source implementation or benchmark output was imported.

decisions.target: existing canonical domain skills and runtime agents
decisions.scope: Do not add duplicate broad sf-apex, sf-flow, sf-lwc, sf-soql, security, deploy, data, schema, and related umbrella packages.
decisions.rationale: Each broad category already maps to richer narrow owners in the 1,039-skill corpus. Importing umbrella skills would create duplicate triggers, competing advice, and a lower-confidence routing layer.
decisions.routing: Route through the existing top-level Salesforce router, domain rosters, and specific runtime commands rather than adding sf-* aliases.

decisions.scope: Do not reuse or advertise an upstream self-reported benchmark as SfSkills evidence.
decisions.rationale: The attached benchmark artifacts were unavailable and the result was not independently reproduced under this repository’s labels, models, prompts, baselines, and anti-circularity rules.
decisions.routing: Use only repository-owned evaluation harnesses and label every result by retrieval path, data set, date, and scoring method.

validation.command: new skill checker passing and failing fixtures

attestation.clean_room: No Clientell wording, code, fixtures, or benchmark data was copied. The Apache-2.0 report was treated as inventory metadata only because the exact supplied archive was unavailable.
attestation.product_boundary: All accepted additions remain read-only analysis, teaching, retrieval, or local validation guidance. They do not deploy, mutate an org, grant authority, or bypass the V2.0/V2.1/V2.2 product gates.
